text:
anya: FYI DAST/SAST evidence uploads failed during a key rotation window. Some scan findings lost attachments, triage slowed.

sam: seeing same for repo payments-core. error was KMS: permission denied when fetching key version.

devops: immediate mitigation = restart scanner pods and reissue ephemeral creds. did that; backlog processing resumed.

infra: long term proposal: (A) use key aliasing so services reference cryptoKey not version, (B) require a pre-rotation "scanner smoke" run 30m before rotation, (C) implement time-bound RBAC grants for scanner SA with TTL=5m and OPA approval.

sec-oncall: also propose audit changes: add scan_run_id to every artifact + KMS request metadata so we can join events quickly. create audit tag "scan_run_id" and include requester principal.

anya: fallback behavior: if KMS decrypt fails pipeline should upload a placeholder evidence file to an internal escrow bucket (restricted ACL, auto-delete 24h) and mark the finding as "evidence_pending" so triage knows. Escrow writes must trigger an alert.

sam: agree but escrow must be opt-in per repo and gated by SRE+sec. will draft gating policy.

ops-bot: automated: created ticket SEC-ESCROW-6160 and incident INC-6160-scan-keystore-rotation.

devops: action items: 1) infra to add smoke check to rotation runbook (ETA 48h) 2) sam to draft escrow gating + retention policy (ETA EOD) 3) anya to add scan_run_id to pipelines (PR by tomorrow) 4) infra to prototype TTL grants + OPA check (POC this week).

infra: will open RFC for aliasing + RBAC flow. will include terraform snippets and smoke script.

(emoji reactions: :mag: from sam, :white_check_mark: from devops)
